provenance.purpose: Pre-change ordered-event and state digest for seed 1 at 200 agents, captured before any weapon-clash code existed. The zero-interception control run in T21 must reproduce every row of it.
provenance.eventFoldSpecification: Per tick, start at the canonical FNV-1a 64-bit offset basis 14695981039346656037 and fold, for each event of that tick in emission order, these nine words with the canonical byte fold: (ulong)Sequence, (ulong)Tick, (ulong)Kind, SourceEntityId, TargetEntityId ?? 0, (ulong)(uint)Value, FactionId is int f ? (ulong)(uint)f : ulong.MaxValue, Weapon is WeaponId w ? (ulong)(uint)(int)w : ulong.MaxValue, HitLocation is BodyPart h ? (ulong)(uint)(int)h : ulong.MaxValue. BattleEvent.Resolution is deliberately excluded: a post-change event carries a field a pre-change event cannot, and folding it would guarantee a mismatch that means nothing.
provenance.stateHashSpecification: The parameterless BattleSimulation.ComputeStateHash() taken immediately after each AdvanceOneTick(). On this commit the ruleset content hash it folds is 0x59FB4CA563D87A49, the same literal T21 passes to the ComputeStateHash(ulong) overload, so the two agree by construction and this capture needs no seam.
